features.name: Clinic home page: name, address, hours, phone
Doctor list with a specialty filter
Slot calendar for the next days
Booking lookup and cancel by booking code
Admin: staff, weekly hours, bookings list

answers.answer: The clinic is open on Saturday and closed on Sunday.
Patients can book up to 14 days ahead.
Patients can cancel up to 2 hours before the appointment.
The phone number is required and has 10 digits.
Yes. There are no slots from 13:00 to 14:00.
The home page loads in under 2 seconds on a 4G phone.
Use the clinic colours green and white, with one column on phones.
Show 7 days per view, with a next-week button up to 14 days.
The admin adds and edits doctors, sets weekly hours and sees the bookings list.
No, reminders are not part of this release.
Each free slot is one button, and one tap opens the booking form.
The confirmation shows the doctor, date, time and a 6-character booking code.
Existing bookings stay, and the admin sees them listed.
No accounts. The booking code is the key.
